properties.evidence: Retires its framing, not its measurement. That node proposed computing the NUMBER OF LAYERS from a 3-7 span-of-control bound, treating the count as the generator of depth. Doctrine puts span of control downstream: structure is derived from grouping FUNCTIONS by cohesion and coupling, and 3-7 is the sanity check on the result. Twenty children means the functional grouping lacked an intermediate cohesion level, not that a rung is owed. Its fan-out measurements stand and remain useful as a check; its causal story does not.
